title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00018 — wellbore not published in this release

RIH w/ 12,25in milling BHA to 135 m

Recorded parameters 400l/min 2bar, 1300l/min 6bar, 2000l/min 9bar, 80rpm 2-5knm, weights up/down 22t/15t. Tagged top of 10 3/4in subsea casing hanger at 139. 7m. Meanwhile finished w/ pumping postflush after batch#1 of drilling slop on f-4. Total postflush pumped of 140m3 batch#1), 1000l/min 150bar. Stopped injection for 2 hours

Milled 10 3/4in subsea casing hanger from 140. 1 to 140. 4 meter. 1500-2000l/min, 11bar, 60-120rpm, MAX 25 KNM, wob 1-8t. Observed good indications of break through reduction of torque and wob. Meanwhile continued w/ pumping drilling slop batch#2 on f-4. Total preflush pumped of 70m3 batch#2), started pumping drilling slop, batch#2, 1000l/min 150bar
Run down and tagged top of 10 3/4in casing stump at 142. 1m. Dressed off top of stump 5 cm, 80-100rpm, 4t wob, 2-4knm, 2000l/min 9bar
Pulled up above casing hanger area and circulated 2x bu 3000 l/min 21bar. Observed no losses, no gas in returns. R/b 1x stand
Performed drops inspection on TDS. Meanwhile carried out TBT for BHA handling
POOH and l/d milling BHA
P/u spear assy Checked and inspected same. RIH to 145m
M/u TDS. Engaged fish. Observed 10t overpull to pull fish free

POOH with casing fish on spear. Set casing fish in slips. Bottom of casing fish at 747m. Meanwhile finished w/ pumping postflush after batch#2 of drilling slop on f-4. Total drilling slop pumped for batch#2 of 250m3, postflush pumped of 140m3 batch#2), 1000l/min 150bar. Stopped injection for 2 hours
Inspected spear, found grapple cracked. Secured grapple and r/b spear BHA in derrick. Meanwhile performed TBT to r/u casing handling equipment
R/u casing handling equipment for 10 3/4in casing
Performed pre-job meeting/brief to pull 10 3/4in x 9 5/8in casing
Removed master bushing and installed power slips

POOH with 10 3/4in casing from 747 to 334m. Average pulling speed 8,5 joints/hr. Meanwhile continued w/ pumping drilling slop batch#3 on f-4. Total preflush pumped of 70m3 batch#3), started pumping drilling slop, batch#3, 1000l/min 145bar
